name: 07480 · West Milford, NJ
findings: ZIP 07480 (West Milford) has 51 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07480 (West Milford) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
